description: Source code for managing and parsing OpenAPI schemas within the Kubernetes Kustomize kyaml project, including schema loading, reference resolution, and resource scope determination.

classes.name: ResourceSchema
classes.description: Wrapper for OpenAPI schema for a resource or field, providing methods for schema navigation and validation.

methods.name: IsMissingOrNull
methods.description: Returns true if the ResourceSchema or its Schema is missing or null.

methods.name: SchemaForResourceType
methods.description: Returns the schema for a given resource type.

methods.name: Elements
methods.description: Returns the schema for array elements if the schema type is array.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Navigates the schema path, calling Elements or Field based on path items.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Returns the schema for a specific field.

methods.name: PatchStrategyAndKeyList
methods.description: Returns patch strategy and merge key list for the schema.

methods.name: PatchStrategyAndKey
methods.description: Returns patch strategy and merge key for the schema.
